experiment: Projection-selective AGQ: small-scale feasibility MVP (2x2 GU x down ablation)
nature: retrospective exploratory pilot; one calibration seed (FR s0); layers 8/16 chosen with knowledge of earlier AGQ outcomes; both test splits previously inspected

tune.note: historical tuning split; disjoint from the C4 pool rows 0-1999 the FR s0 calibration set was drawn from; the ONLY split used for expert selection and the layer-wise baseline choice

confirm.note: document-disjoint confirmation split; identical windows to runs_legacy_metric_reeval; inspected in earlier studies -> not pristine

oldtest.note: historical test rows 2128-2255; inspected in many prior studies

metric: E_layer = sum ||y_BF16 - y_q||^2 / (sum ||y_BF16||^2 + 1e-30); complete expert outputs with the actual mixed weights in fp32; frozen BF16 inputs, fp32 softmax top-4 c (no renorm), shared expert included; LayerEvalAccumulator definition
aggregate: mean of the L8 and L16 ratios (2-layer scope, not comparable to 4-layer historical means)

selection.rule: per layer z* = argmin over {GPTQ, GU_AGQ, DOWN_AGQ, FULL_AGQ} of tuning-split E_layer; exact ties -> GPTQ > FULL_AGQ > GU_AGQ > DOWN_AGQ
selection.layerwise_uniform_baseline: per layer GPTQ vs FULL_AGQ on tuning E_layer; ties -> GPTQ

regression.gate: A and D must reproduce historical per-window values and totals (rel <= 1e-9) before B/C are evaluated anywhere

decision_rule.PROMISING: all: (1) a mixed config selected on validation for some layer beats both uniform configs there on validation AND on confirmation; (2) 2-layer mean selected vs validation-selected layer-wise uniform <= -tau (confirm); (3) per layer selected vs best uniform (confirm) <= +tau; (4) old-test selected vs layer-wise 2-layer mean < 0; (5) correctness; (6) cost: 2-layer mean selected vs uniform FULL_AGQ (1x preparation cost) <= -tau
decision_rule.SELECTION_FAIL: not promising; a mixed config was selected because it beat both uniform configs on validation, but on confirmation it does not beat the better uniform config of that layer
decision_rule.LOCAL_GAIN: not the above; on confirmation some mixed config beats the best uniform config of some layer by >= tau
decision_rule.INTERACTION_ONLY: not the above; on a layer where |FULL_AGQ vs GPTQ| >= tau, |I| / |E_A - E_D| >= 0.25 on confirmation, OR in some layer >= 10 % of experts have a mixed config whose confirmation c^2-weighted expert error is lower than both uniform configs by >= 1 % relative
decision_rule.BLOCKED: candidate invalid or any correctness check fails

post_hoc: L16 expert 40 attribution is post-hoc mechanism exploration (identified from earlier results); never used for selection or decision
